label: Careerjet
terms_note: Aggregator with a partner search API (affiliate id); apply on the source site.

sdks: https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/ (code examples in several languages; legacy .NET client docs referenced in robots.txt)

endpoints.call: api for search — Careerjet Publisher Search API v4: GET https://search.api.careerjet.net/v4/query with HTTP Basic (API key as user name, empty password) and REQUIRED user_ip + user_agent of the end us
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: No published rate limit; Publisher programme (free sign-up as publisher → per-site API key) intended to 'embed Careerjet's job search results on your site' / monetise traffic; each call must carry the real end-user's IP and user agent (403 'Missing param user_ip or user_agent' otherwise) — server-side batch crawling without a user context is outside the design. XML job feeds also offered to publishers. No published rate limit; robots.txt disallows /apply/, /apply2/, /search/rss.html.
mcp_sdk: https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/ (code examples in several languages; legacy .NET client docs referenced in robots.txt)

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Careerjet publisher API key (free publisher sign-up at https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/); sent as the HTTP Basic user name with an empty password.

fields.name: user_ip
fields.help: The end user's IP address, required by Careerjet as the user_ip query parameter on every call (403 'Missing param user_ip or user_agent' otherwise).

fields.name: user_agent
fields.help: The end user's browser user agent, required by Careerjet as the user_agent query parameter on every call.

me.note: Verified with a one-result query (Careerjet has no account endpoint).

search.note: Publisher Search API v4: page 1-10, page_size ≤ 100. Results are Careerjet redirect URLs to the original posting and no job id is documented, so url doubles as id; salary is a free-text string left in raw. An ambiguous location yields a LOCATIONS response with no jobs. Every call carries the configured end user's user_ip and user_agent as the publisher terms require; locale_code, contract_type, work_hours and sort are not exposed. No published rate limit.

not_offered.get_posting: No per-job endpoint is documented ('job_details (excerpt + redirect URL)' come from the search hit).
not_offered.apply: Page: 'Aggregator — applying happens on the source site (assist)'; robots.txt disallows /apply/ and /apply2/.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the search endpoint is documented.
